## similarity and association of the measurements BL, PL, PABW, TABW
```{r}
df_NoLA %>%
  # 1. Reshape the data to long format
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(BL, PL, PABW, TABW), 
    names_to = "Measurement", 
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  # 2. Plot the data
  ggplot(aes(x = exp_day, y = Value, color = Measurement, fill = Measurement)) +
  
  # Scatter plot points
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Trend lines (method = "lm" for linear, or leave blank for a smooth LOESS curve)
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", alpha = 0.1, size = 1) + 
  
  # Your custom color palette (applies to points and lines)
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "BL" = "#343434", 
    "PL"  = "#8FABB7", 
    "PABW"  = "#3880ba", 
    "TABW"  = "#b8ac92"
  )) +
  
  # Custom fill palette (applies to the geom_smooth error shading)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "BL" = "#343434", 
    "PL"  = "#8FABB7", 
    "PABW"  = "#3880ba", 
    "TABW"  = "#b8ac92"
  )) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Measurement Trends Over Time",
    x = "Experimental Day",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(segmented)
measure_cols <- colnames(df_NoLA[,7:20])
df_NoLA_sg <- df_NoLA %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(measure_cols), 
                ~ log(.x), 
                .names = "log_{.col}")
  )%>%
  mutate(log_vol = log(vol))

model1 <- lm(log_TBL ~ log_vol, data = df_NoLA_sg)

segmented_model1 <- segmented(model1, seg.Z = ~log_vol)

df_NoLA_sg$seg_preds1 <- predict(segmented_model1)

pp1 <- ggplot(df_NoLA_sg, aes(x = log_vol, y = log_TBL, color = cluster_shape)) +
  #geom_point(color = "#3880ba", alpha = 0.8) +                # Scatter plot of raw data
    geom_point()+
  geom_line(aes(y = seg_preds1), color = "#343434", size = 1) + # Piecewise regression line
  theme_classic() +
    labs(y = "Log TBL")

pp2 <- ggplot(df_NoLA_sg, aes(x = log_vol, y = log_TBL, color = stage)) +
  #geom_point(color = "#3880ba", alpha = 0.8) +                # Scatter plot of raw data
    geom_point()+
  geom_line(aes(y = seg_preds1), color = "#343434", size = 1) + # Piecewise regression line
  theme_classic() +
    labs(y = "Log TBL")
```
